description: Defines the VideoRateControlWrapper class and related structures for video rate control, including configuration, frame parameters, and internal implementation interface, specific to Windows GPU media processing.

classes.name: VideoRateControlWrapper
classes.description: Base class for computing quantization parameters for video frames.

classes.name: VideoRateControlWrapperInternal
classes.description: Template class for creating codec-specific rate controllers, inheriting from VideoRateControlWrapper.

methods.name: UpdateRateControl
methods.description: Updates rate control parameters based on configuration.

methods.name: ComputeQP
methods.description: Computes the quantization parameter for a given frame.

methods.name: GetLoopfilterLevel
methods.description: Returns loop filter level, applicable for VP9.

methods.name: PostEncodeUpdate
methods.description: Provides feedback after encoding a frame.
